description: Two step-dispatched bursts of eight2049-token synthetic prompts with2048shared content tokens, cancellationat72, secondburst at88. Each run starts with empty prefix cache; secondburst can reuse the firstburst cache.
required_observations: Complete exact output/finish verification across all four runs
Every request settles once; cold-7 cancellation exercised
Shared attention counters positive in shared variant and zero in baseline
Actual peak batch occupancy, cache hits, TTFT/ITL tails, useful throughput and KV use reported
limitations: Step arrivals are deterministic scheduler traffic, not wall-clock arrival deadlines
Synthetic tokenids are not a language quality test
192blocks bound capacity but do not force preemption; no claim of a pressure test
Model loading and initial engine warmup excluded; cold request prefill included
Two repeats provide descriptive lifecycle checks rather than a reliable speed confidence bound
